title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15

ai_review.summary: Recording is essentially silent with static, making it unlistenable.
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer reports that nothing can be heard beyond static, indicating a failed capture. With no audible music the performance cannot be judged, and the tape offers little to no listening value.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief 1‑star review describing complete lack of audio; recording quality is clearly poor and there is insufficient information to assess the show itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: All static, no discernible music or dialogue; effectively inaudible.
